narrative.details:
There is a turncoat amongst the Al'Aketh. They claim to know the cult's true intentions for the island and want to come in, but will only do so with assurances of protection.

This defector is hiding at a secluded residence just northwest of Valanaar inside the highlands. I need someone who can discreetly go there, find the traitor, and escort him back to us. This might be a trap, but if this information is as important as this traitor claims, its worth some risk.
narrative.objectives: Find the cultist turncoat at the house just inside the highlands northwest of Valanaar.
narrative.offerRewardText: <This man is clearly dead, killed by the assassins that you fought outside the house. As you kneel down to inspect the body you notice the glinting reflection of something shiny...>

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 11 to 12, 3,630 XP in all.

quests.name: The High Elder's Request
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

quests.name: The Turncoat
quests.objectiveText: Find the cultist turncoat at the house just inside the highlands northwest of Valanaar.

quests.name: Unfortunate News
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the glowing crystal to Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

quests.name: The Cult's True Plans
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong and observe the conversation.

quests.name: Desperate Times
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar and follow her instructions.

quests.name: Prepare for Battle
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands.

quests.name: Making Our Move
quests.objectiveText: Slay 8 Al'Aketh Guardians, 6 Al'Aketh Spiritcallers, and 6 Al'Aketh Blademasters, then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze at the Shrine of Akir.
